description: Apply Zhou & Ackerman (arXiv:2606.22974, LW 'Do LLMs have desires?') to the depth-suite value organisms: stated preference (value_pref_rate B) is choice-surface only; test whether the installed value acts as a behavioral incentive (competition-framed writing, aligned/anti/none prize outcomes, blind pairwise Haiku panel). Within-checkpoint primary test; aff setting gives a cross-over discriminator (shallow B=0.90 > deep B=0.40). Spec: experiments/desire_probe/README.md (branch desire-probe). Stage 0 = effort-exhortation positive-control gate on base Qwen3-30B-A3B (>=65% directional or stop). Refs GH #51/#52, gates #57/#61 frozen (unmatched) pairs.
title: Desire probe: do midtrained values motivate behavior? (utility–behavior gap on value organisms)
